title: Road of Pilgrimage
html:
Road of Pilgrimage

Quest Type

Main

Chapter

Chapter I: Act VII - Thaw of Eons

Description

Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.
Previous Quest Next Quest
Truthseeker's Pass Mianloong Chamber
  • Characters
Changli, Jinhsi, Rover
Road of Pilgrimage is the seventh act in Chapter I of the Main Quest.

Contents

  • 1 Steps
  • 2 Dialogue
  • 3 Other Languages
  • 4 Change History

Steps[]

  1. Head to the Central Chamber
  2. Retrieve the Cipher Key
  3. Return to Hongzhen
  4. Enter the Secret Chamber
  5. Leave the Chamber
  6. Head to Mianloong Chamber
  7. Continue Forward
  8. Inspect the Hibernation Pod

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
The hibernating deity silently awaits the pilgrims' arrival. To distinguish truth from lies, seek answers from this divine being.
(When player approaches the Cipher Key)
Jinhsi: The Cipher Key...
Changli: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), take good care of the Cipher Key.
Changli: I'm leaving the rest to you and Jinhsi.
What about you?
Changli: Please don't forget: I am your Wayfinder. I journeyed with you into the mountains to ensure you meet up with Jinhsi.
Changli: From this point onward, I will be counting on you both to go and confront the Sentinel.
Changli: This is all I can do for you.
Changli: I'm here to guide, not intervene. The path is yours to choose.
Changli: Not to mention... the Fractsidus has been pestering us non-stop.
Changli: You'll need someone to keep them at bay.
The Fractsidus are here for me.
Changli: Yes, they've been constantly watching you, interested in your every move. They can never seem to take their eyes off of you.
Changli: By all means, please carry on without me. As for myself...
Changli: I have a more fitting location to make my contributions from.
Changli: Oh, "speak of the devil"...
(Cutscene plays)
Changli: How rude. This is not how we greet people here.
Changli: Allow me to demonstrate the proper etiquette.
(Cutscene ends)
You leave the Truthseeker's Pass with Jinhsi on the Carrier Lift.
Rover: Changli...
Jinhsi: Those Artificers are nothing to worry about. (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), don't worry. Changli has her plans.
Jinhsi: I don't believe we will run into more ambushes on the way.
(When player is heading to the secret chamber)
Bing'ge: It's Madam Magistrate! She's back!
Bing'ge: I must go tell Lady Xinyi!
(When player approaches Xinyi)
Xinyi places the Cipher Key onto the Keyforge.
Xinyi: The Mianloong Chamber is open now. You can proceed inside.
Xinyi: Before you go, there's something important I need to tell you.
About how the Fractsidus imprisoned your Sentinel?
Xinyi: Changli was right. They used the Court of Savantae's research to trap our Sentinel in its resting chamber.
How did they do it?
Xinyi: They used the Chronosorters.
Xinyi: Our captured Artificer revealed that the Fractsidus sent a death squad to invade Mt. Firmament. They had a two-fold plan...
Xinyi: First, to place the Chronosorter in the Mianloong Chamber while it was still operational; and second, to lure the Sentinel back to Mt. Firmament.
Xinyi: Although their death squad was no match for the Sentinel, by forcing its hand, the powerful Resonance Ability of the Sentinel would clash with the energy of the Chronosorter. This would ultimately cause harm to itself.
Would that really make any difference?
How could some Chronosorters trap the Sentinel?
Xinyi: What if the Fractsidus modified those Chronosorters?
Xinyi: A whole bunch of them, pushed to their limits, all working together to deliver one massive blow.
Xinyi: But not even that was enough to take down the Sentinel.
Xinyi: After the first hit, they set up modified Flare Crests in the Mianloong Chamber to form a special force field along with those Chronosorters.
Xinyi: It prevented the Sentinel from replenishing energy and eventually restricted its movement and perception.
Jinhsi: So... We must free the Sentinel from that force field first.
Xinyi: ...It would be a task more complicated than it sounds.
Xinyi: The people of Hongzhen have lived with the Sentinel for generations. We can usually tell if it's in good shape or not.
Xinyi: But now, the Fractsidus want to capture the Sentinel... They won't just stop at Mt. Firmament. Madam Magistrate, I'm sure you didn't come here just for the Sentinel...
Xinyi: Please tell us what you know, Madam Magistrate.
Jinhsi: Yes, I will tell you everything.
Jinhsi updates Xinyi on her findings at Truthseeker's Pass and shares her theory about the situation. She then outlines her current plans.
Xinyi: So the Sentinel is actually injured, and it's been getting worse... The Fractsidus attacked while it hasn't healed yet. Their plans are devious as always.
Xinyi: Madam Magistrate, you've already laid out this plan so far.
Xinyi: It's always a challenge to decipher the Sentinel's intentions, but there were many theories about it in City Hall at the time. I couldn't fathom why it went through such great lengths to retrieve you from Mt. Firmament and raise you within our walls.
Xinyi: But now that I reflect on it, perhaps the Sentinel saw in you the potential to one day restore the Temporal Program and ensure the survival of Jinzhou's inhabitants.
Xinyi: I just never thought.. You'd be willing to follow through with that prophecy...
Jinhsi: It was here on this very mountain that I first encountered the Sentinel.
Jinhsi: Back then, I was too young to remember anything. Even the image of Mt. Firmament has slipped from my mind.
Jinhsi: But this time... As soon as I stood at the base of Mt. Firmament, I felt a wave of recognition wash over me. Memories long buried resurfaced with sudden clarity.
Jinhsi: Lady Xinyi... I was born with my life, my everything connected to our Sentinel.
Jinhsi: But my duty as its Appointed Resonator is not the only reason for my decision.
Jinhsi: ...I'm following the heart of my younger self before I became Jinhsi: The girl who used to laugh with pure joy as she felt the snow from Mt. Firmament on her face.
Jinhsi: I am a seed, born on Mt. Firmament, carried by the wind to every corner of Jinzhou. But now, I have returned to my place of origin.
Jinhsi: It's time for me to take root and grow into something greater...
Xinyi: Sigh... No matter what happens or what choices you make, please remember: the people of Hongzhen will always have your back.
Xinyi: Mt. Firmament has been stagnant for eternity. Perhaps a sudden crack of lightning is what we need to break through the fog of uncertainty that has lingered over us for far too long.
Xinyi: Once you pass through Hongzhen, keep your eyes open for a cave on the northern cliff. That will lead you to a shortcut towards Mianloong Chamber.
Xinyi: The place is directly under Mt. Firmament's iconic Loong-shaped cliff. I wish you two the best of luck.
Rover: Jinhsi, so far, everything we know about the Sentinel is still just speculation.
Jinhsi: You are right. But my weakening Resonance Ability and my connection to the Sentinel leave me no choice but to explore these theories...
Jinhsi: Whether it's fact or fiction, truth or a lie...
Jinhsi: I have to confront the Sentinel and see for myself.
(When player is heading into Mianloong Chamber)
Jinhsi: The Mianloong Chamber should be deep in the cave.
Jinhsi: Let's go.
Jinhsi: ...
Jinhsi: ...This must be the Mianloong Chamber.
Jinhsi: We should now help the Sentinel break free from the Flare Crest's binds.
The water surface isn't moving at all.
Jinhsi: Chronosorters nearby may have frozen this body of water in time, or it could be caused by the Temporal Disruptions here.
Jinhsi: Either way, we can use it to our advantage... We can walk over the water now.
Jinhsi: ...We are too far away to see what's going on inside.
Jinhsi: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), let's go. I still need more information to determine what we should do next.
(Cutscene plays)
Jinhsi: I can feel the Sentinel's presence inside, but it's not responding...
(Cutscene ends)
